resources.string: Stamina %1$d · hold to charge · secondary: guard
Action: equip · Equipment menu: inspect / remove
Make room in the bag before changing equipment.
Aim at a deep pool, then cast with Action. Bait speeds up bites.
Line cast… wait for a bite, then press Action.
Find a wider pool, at least two blocks deep.
Fish are wary here. Try another pool or return in a little while.

Melee: tap Action for a quick hit; hold and release for a heavy hit. Secondary raises a short guard: perfect timing parries frontal hits. Carry a buckler and equip it with Action. Armor works while worn, even with a bow. Use the Equipment menu to inspect or remove worn gear. Forge metals in an ember forge, then craft equipment beside an anvil. Fishing: cast at deep water, press Action at the bite, then keep the fish inside the gauge zone by holding and releasing Action.
Damage %1$d · reach %2$.1f blocks\nRecovery %3$.2f s · targets %4$d · stamina %5$d\nTap Action for a quick hit; hold and release to charge. Secondary guards. Heavy hits interrupt enemies.
Reduces combat damage by %1$d%% while worn. Select in the hotbar and press Action to equip. Equipment menu: inspect or remove.
Equip with Action. Secondary guards for a short time; a well-timed frontal parry cancels damage. Ordinary blocks absorb %1$d%% with a buckler, %2$d%% with a weapon. Guarding consumes stamina.
Cook fish over fuel, simmer with potatoes and onions, or press two fish into oil. Oil makes lamps; hamlet traders also buy catches and oil. A fished pool rests for 75 seconds of active play.

Forge: iron + coal → blank; resonant geode + coal → resonant powder. Anvil: assemble melee weapons, armor, firearm parts and ammunition nearby. The mechanical press improves plate, rivet and cartridge-case yields.
